extracted.intended_audience: international non-U.S.-based research entities (academia/industry) and multinational teams seeking ONR Global research grants for the GlobalX AI for Advancing Maritime Security Challenge
extracted.subtask_short: GlobalX Challenge white papers and proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit white papers, quad charts, spreadsheets, Proposal Pitch Day presentations, and full grant proposals in response to ONR Global's GlobalX Innovation Joint Challenge (BAA Call N0001425SBC03). The guidance covers eligibility, technical scope (AI for maritime scene perception), formatting, submission channels, evaluation, funding limits, and award conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revolutionary capability (scope and novelty)
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR Global is interested in promising applied concepts to realize revolutionary capability advancements with dual-use military and commercial value related to the multidisciplinary problem statement. Specifically excluded are concepts duplicative to existing S&T programs, evolutionary enhancements to existing technologies, and/or modernization efforts for existing commercial systems or products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should focus on revolutionary (not incremental) applied concepts. The evaluation panel will assess how well submissions achieve the 'revolutionary capability' described in the Challenge Problem Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical focus: maritime scene perception
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must 1) define challenging and realistic maritime scene perception scenarios represented by real-world and/or synthetic data generated by sensors commonly found on UxV platforms, and 2) present innovative AI algorithms that can successfully operate on that representative data and determine operational context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected proposals should describe both the construction of a maritime scenario (simulation or physical environment) and the technical details of the novel software-based AI algorithms for UxVs operating in this environment. Example scenarios include traffic management, collision detection and avoidance, anomaly detection and lifelong learning, and port security and surveillance. The type of UxV platform (surface, underwater, or airborne) will be weighted equally in evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliverable: maritime scenario dataset
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliverables include the maritime scenario dataset used by performers in this challenge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams must provide the dataset (real-world or synthetic) that represents the maritime scenarios used for algorithm development and evaluation. The spreadsheet submission must indicate the particular Challenge Problem Statement addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: White paper format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: White papers shall be 12-point Times New Roman font and not exceed five single-sided pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Figures, charts and tables should be legible but may use a smaller font size. White papers should follow the provided White Paper Template and meet mandatory ONRG Cover Page requirements. The five-page limit applies only to the white paper body (quad chart and spreadsheet are separate). Late white papers may not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required white paper attachments and file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: White papers must include an additional one-page quad chart and a spreadsheet, which are not part of the white paper page limitation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: White paper: Adobe PDF (preferred) or Microsoft Word. Quad chart: Adobe PDF (preferred) or Microsoft PowerPoint. Spreadsheet: Microsoft Excel (or compatible). Do not alter the order or add additional columns to the spreadsheet. The spreadsheet should indicate the particular Challenge Problem Statement the white paper addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: White paper submission method and naming
rubrics_metrics.description: White papers must be submitted by email to usn.ncr.onrghq.list.grantsproposals@us.navy.mil by the posted deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The subject line of the email shall read: "N0001425SBC03 GlobalX Challenge White Paper Submission." Do not send ZIP files or provide links to 'Dropbox' type applications as they will not be reviewed. Password protected files are discouraged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility of lead and team composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposing team must be led by an eligible non-U.S.-based research entity (academia, industry, or broader scientific community). U.S.-based non-federal entities may participate as part of a multi-national team but are not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR Global expects the majority of team members will be entities outside the U.S. Each team shall designate a lead Principal Investigator (PI) whose organization outside of the U.S. will submit the white paper or proposal and be responsible for distributing funding to co-PIs and sub-recipients. Eligibility requirements are detailed in the BAA (Section C and ONRG overview).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions related to sanctions and export controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations and individuals that are not subject to U.S. sanctions or otherwise excluded from doing business with the U.S. Government may participate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The grant applicant is responsible for complying with any applicable sanctions, export controls, and similar limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount and period of performance
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR Global expects to award up to a total of $250,000 for an initial twelve-month period of performance; at ONR Global's discretion, an additional twelve-month optional period may be considered following a successful proof of concept. Total award values will not exceed $500,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR Global may award one or multiple grants; number and amounts depend on proposals submitted. Initial 12-month period expected to demonstrate proof-of-concept; optional 12-month period for continued development/testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation pathway: white paper -> Pitch Day -> full proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: The Challenge evaluation panel will assess white papers and invite teams with the most promising concepts to submit a full proposal or participate in a Proposal Pitch Day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposal Pitch Day provides an opportunity to present ideas and interactively answer questions. Invitations do not guarantee awards. Full proposals may be submitted by any applicant whether or not they submitted a white paper or participated in the Pitch Day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full proposal submission channel and prerequisites
rubrics_metrics.description: Full grant proposals must be submitted via www.grants.gov under BAA number N0001425SBC03 by the posted deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SAM registration is required to submit proposals on grants.gov and may require significant time to complete for new registrants. ONR Global is not obligated to consider late full proposals. Full Proposals will be evaluated in accordance with Section E.2 Review and Selection Process within BAA N0001425SB001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-award obligations and prime awardee responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: For a given project team, one award is made to the PI’s institution. Only the PI’s institution will be the prime awardee and is responsible for all aspects of the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The prime awardee must adhere to conditions on the use of funds and other terms and conditions of the grant, provide regular performance reporting and a final research progress report, and submit required financial and patent reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment emphasis: demonstration of proof-of-concept
rubrics_metrics.description: During the initial period of performance ONR Global expects performers to show proof their concept will likely meet proposed objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrable progress toward objectives in the initial 12 months is expected to inform any decision on exercising the optional additional period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative question submission process
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions regarding the announcement must be provided to the Business Point of Contact in writing by electronic mail, and questions regarding White Papers or Full Proposals should be submitted no later than five working days before the recommended receipt dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answers to submitted questions will be posted in the FAQ document on the GlobalX website and grants.gov. Questions received after the recommended date may not be answered.
